Pink Floyd - A Saucerful of Secrets

Bit of background story:

I used to have an old crappy keyboard with a recording function. The keyboard was a bit broken and the "play" button was stuck so every time you turned the power on, it would play the last piece of music recorded.

One night there was a storm and the power went out as I was sleeping. I had recorded the keyboard part from this song and then sort of forgot about it. I'd left the keyboard on and once the power came back, the recording started playing loudly and woke me up.

Waking up to a ghost playing this song in a thunderstorm definitely added to its inherent creepiness.

"Careful With That Axe, Eugene" and the middle part from "Echoes" also used to creep me out (they're also much better songs) but I don't want to spam the sub with too much Pink Floyd, and this was the one that once really terrified me.

Ah, Pink Floyd. Their stuff can get pretty surreal. Pretty much this entire album can get creepy in the right settings.

Also, feel free to post all the Pink Floyd you want (provided it's creepy, of course). The community is just starting out and it's great seeing anything new.
